description.zh:
API调用地址的自定义部分。作为API资源标识符，需具有全局唯一性。

> API调用地址的前一段部分由系统生成。
description.en:
The custom part of the API invocation path. As a resource identifier for the API, it must be globally unique.

> The preceding segment of the API invocation path is generated by the system.

description.zh: API的显示名称，需具有全局唯一性。仅支持中文汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、连接符（-）、英文圆括号和空格，长度不超过20个字符。
description.en: The display name of the API, which must be globally unique. It supports only Chinese characters, English letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), English parentheses, and spaces, with a maximum length of 20 characters.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: Instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify it for Enterprise instances.

description.zh:
API对应的原始SQL，指定数据开发的SQL样式。

例如`select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = 1`。其中，`${system.device}`是平台系统的设备表，具体请参见[数据表](~~120902~~)中的表说明。
description.en:
The original SQL corresponding to the API, specifying the SQL style for data development.

For example: `select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = 1`. Here, `${system.device}` refers to the device table in the platform system. For details, see the table descriptions in [Data Table](~~120902~~).

description.zh:
参数名称。

例如，`${status}`格式的模板参数，参数名称就是`status`。
description.en:
Parameter name.

For example, for a template parameter in the format `${status}`, the parameter name is `status`.

description.zh:
该参数是否必填。

- true：必填。
- false：非必填。

默认值为true。
description.en:
Indicates whether the parameter is required.

- true: Required.
- false: Optional.

Default value is true.

description.zh: 参数类型，请参见[JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html)。目前仅支持：ARRAY、VARCHAR、INTEGER、BIGINT、BOOLEAN、DECIMAL、TIMESTAMP。
description.en: Parameter type. For more information, see [JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html). Currently supported types are: ARRAY, VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL, and TIMESTAMP.

description.zh:
该参数是否必填。

- true：必填。
- false：非必填。

> 返回参数中，此参数无需处理。
description.en:
Indicates whether the parameter is required.

- true: Required.
- false: Optional.

> This parameter does not need to be processed in the response.

description.zh: 参数类型，请参见[JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html)。目前仅支持：VARCHAR、INTEGER、BIGINT、BOOLEAN、DECIMAL、TIMESTAMP。
description.en: Parameter type. For more information, see [JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html). Currently supported types are: VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL, and TIMESTAMP.

description.zh:
服务的模板SQL，即原始SQL的模板化。

例如`select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = ${status}`。其中，`${status}`是模板化的参数。支持设置模板参数为动态值。
description.en:
The template SQL statement for the service, which is a templated version of the original SQL.

For example, `select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = ${status}`. In this example, `${status}` is a templated parameter. Dynamic values can be configured for template parameters.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为1。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can make a maximum of 1 query per second (QPS) to this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
